provenance.oracle_source: git archive 981d25c go.mod go.sum as module context; the capture program imports only the Go standard library (fmt, encoding/json, strconv, math)
provenance.go_formatters: fmt %v and json.Marshal reach internal/strconv dboxFtoa64 (Dragonbox shortest); fmt %.1f reaches the fixed-precision path
provenance.command: docker run --rm --network none -e GOTOOLCHAIN=local -e GOPROXY=off -e GOFLAGS=-mod=readonly -e GOCACHE=/tmp/gocache -v <git archive 981d25c go.mod go.sum, plus scratch cmd/floatcapture>:/src:ro -v <out>:/out -w /src <image> go run ./cmd/floatcapture /out
provenance.line_format: %016x of the float64 bits, TAB, fmt %v, TAB, fmt %.1f, TAB, json.Marshal, LF
provenance.scope: Frozen Go outputs for differential parity of humanymous_core::signals::wire float formatting only; never regenerate to hide drift

generator.families: 2^e for e in [-1074, 1023], then the parsed decimal 1eN for N in [-323, 308]
generator.seeded: 40000 finite bit patterns (exponent 0x7ff has bit 52 flipped), 20000 bit patterns uniform over [0,2], 20000 over [10,95], 20000 dyadic k/2^m in [0,2] (m in [1,52]), 20000 dyadic in [10,95] (m in [1,46]), 20000 parsed decimals of 1-17 digits with exponent in [-10,3]
generator.tiehunt: 500000 dyadic k/2^m, m in [10,24], alternating [0,2] and [10,95] (the [10,95] draw follows a discarded [0,2] draw)

cases_selection: all 29 named edge values, then the distinct lines of the families, seeded and tiehunt streams (in that order) where the previous Rust {:e}-based formatter disagreed with Go, to 3000 cases; these are shortest-digit ties that Go breaks to even
